reason: profiles/pi carries pi-sandbox-guard 7ad441f's Pi profile with the protections Agent Guard adds to Pi sessions (docs/DESIGN.md section 11). Every change to a vendored file is in the patch and listed here; test/pi-files.mjs checks both, and test/pi-launch.mjs tests each difference.

LICENSE.note: From b60240a, the pi-sandbox-guard commit after 7ad441f that changed only LICENSE's copyright line, to name pi-sandbox-guard contributors.

added.package.json: Replaces 7ad441f's package.json, whose scripts run the npm deploy, bind and status commands that Agent Guard replaces; keeps the module fields.

not_vendored.scripts/test-ops.sh: Tests pi-sandbox-guard's npm deploy, status and bind scripts, which Agent Guard replaces.
not_vendored.scripts/deploy-all.sh, scripts/deploy-la: Replaced by Agent Guard's installer and CI.
not_vendored.scripts/bind-executable.sh, scripts/lib-: Replaced by agent-guard bind and doctor; the vendored suites do not need them.
not_vendored.test/e2e-demo.mjs: A manual demonstration, not a suite.
not_vendored.config/, docs/, README.md, SECURITY.md,: pi-sandbox-guard's own documentation and repository files.

differences.change: Agent Guard's base write protections, appended after pi-sandbox-guard's rules: the engine folder, OpenCode Guard's engine folder, ~/Agent Guard, ~/Applications/Agent Guard.app, ~/.config/opencode, ~/.opencode, ~/.cc-safety-net except its logs, ~/Library/LaunchAgents and the eight shell startup files, plus the resolved target of each one that is a symlink at launch (engine/launch's rule: it exists and resolves elsewhere), passed as AG_LINK_* parameters with an inert path when there is no link.

A project that is, contains or is inside one of difference 1's folders, or the link target of one, is refused before launch, beside the preamble's existing boundary and agent-config refusals. The shell startup files are files, so their link targets are protected but not refused. All of ~/.cc-safety-net is refused, its logs included.

Decision D7, as in engine/profile.sb: (deny lsopen), (deny job-creation) and (deny process-exec) of /usr/bin/open, /usr/bin/osascript, /usr/bin/osacompile, /usr/bin/codesign, /usr/sbin/diskutil, /bin/launchctl and /usr/bin/sudo.

Step 7's protections under Pi's ~/.cache grant, for C = ~/.cache and C = the canonical XDG_CACHE_HOME: writes to C/opencode/packages, C/opencode/node_modules, C/opencode/bin, C/opencode/models.json and C/opencode/models-*.json are denied, and C and C/opencode are pinned with literal denies. XDG_CACHE_HOME travels as AG_XDG_CACHE_HOME, ~/.cache when unset; a value that is not an existing absolute folder refuses the launch.
The preamble's repair messages name agent-guard bind instead of npm run bind, and drop 'from the repo checkout'.

test_edits.change: sb, sb_omp and sb_pi_relocated pass the profile's AG_* parameters with inert values, read from the profile, since a missing parameter stops the profile from compiling.
runNestedShim passes the profile's AG_* parameters with inert values, read from the profile; the ambient-override refusal case expects agent-guard bind instead of npm run bind.
